name: gemini-llm
title: Gemini
description: Google Gemini as a backup brain: free, no card, generous limits. One gateway to one service, installable into any running nyyon — the host discovers it by capability, not by name.

gateways.purpose: Google Gemini over its OpenAI-compatible endpoint

tables.name: plugin_gemini_llm_config
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plugin_gemini_llm_config (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, api_key TEXT NOT NULL, model TEXT, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

def.name: connect_gemini
def.description: Connect Google Gemini as a backup brain for this install. Free key at aistudio.google.com/apikey (no card). The right model is discovered for the key and verified with a real request.

api_key.description: the AIza... key from AI Studio

def.name: disconnect_gemini
def.description: Forget the Gemini key. Nyo falls back to whatever other brain is available.

def.name: gemini_status
def.description: Is Gemini connected as a backup brain, and on which model? Pass check:true to confirm it answers with a real request.
